whoItsFor: Developers and creative coders who want to study or adapt a deterministic, code-rendered music video pipeline with word-synced karaoke typography. It also suits anyone who needs to regenerate lyric and beat timing data for a song.
useCases: Preview the music video live in the browser with frame-accurate scrubbing
Render a 1080p60 or 4K60 MP4 offline with motion blur
Regenerate word-level lyric and beat timing data via forced alignment

requirements.runtime: bun, Google Chrome, ffmpeg with libx264; uv for the analysis tools
